resources.string: ٱلْـحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ، وَٱلصَّلَاةُ وَٱلسَّلَامُ عَلَىٰ خَاتِمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ، أَمَّا بَعْدُ، فَأَعُوذُ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ، بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

Sunnahs and manners regarding different topics are being presented. Do not consider every Madani pearl presented to be a Sunnah. There is a possibility that these Madani pearls may contain sayings of pious predecessors besides Sunnahs. Remember the ruling that no deed can be declared ‘Sunnah of the beloved Prophet’ unless it is known for sure.
Help us improve Sunnah Al-Hadi by reporting any issues you encounter. JazakAllahu Khair!
Allow Sunnah Al-Hadi to send you gentle daily %1$s reminders about the beautiful Sunnah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
These reminders will help you incorporate blessed practices into your daily routine, In Sha Allah.
